title: DSPy Signature Definitions
summary: This module defines the core mechanisms for creating and managing DSPy signatures, including a metaclass for dynamic signature generation and utilities for handling legacy field types.

nodes.label: Convert Field to Legacy Type
nodes.title: Field Type Converter
nodes.description: A utility function that transforms a modern DSPy field (based on Pydantic's FieldInfo) into an instance of either `OldInputField` or `OldOutputField`, preserving its properties for backward compatibility.

nodes.label: Legacy Input Field
nodes.title: Old Input Field Definition
nodes.description: Represents a legacy input field within a DSPy signature. It defines properties like prefix, description, and format, specifically marking the field as an input type for older signature structures.

nodes.label: Legacy Output Field
nodes.title: Old Output Field Definition
nodes.description: Represents a legacy output field within a DSPy signature. It defines properties like prefix, description, and format, specifically marking the field as an output type for older signature structures.

nodes.label: Define DSPy Signatures
nodes.title: DSPy Signature Metaclass
nodes.description: The metaclass responsible for dynamically creating and validating DSPy `Signature` classes. It handles field ordering, type inference, default instructions, and ensures fields are correctly defined as input or output types, extending Pydantic's BaseModel capabilities.

nodes.label: Pydantic BaseModel
nodes.title: Pydantic's BaseModel
nodes.description: The foundational class from Pydantic that provides data validation, settings management, and serialization. DSPy signatures are built upon its structure and validation capabilities.

groups.label: Signature Definition
groups.title: Core Signature Definition
groups.description: Components responsible for the dynamic creation and validation of DSPy Signature classes, leveraging Pydantic's data modeling capabilities.

groups.label: Legacy Field Handling
groups.title: Legacy Field Conversion & Types
groups.description: Utilities and classes for converting and representing older DSPy field types, ensuring backward compatibility with previous signature definitions.
